symbols.name: block base
symbols.meaning: The base of the digits in a block, a fixed integer at least 2.
symbols.quote: $B$ is the base, a fixed integer with $B \ge 2$; each digit lies between $0$ and $B-1$.

symbols.name: block length
symbols.meaning: The number of digit places in each block, counting zeros.
symbols.quote: $L$ is the number of digit places in each block, a count of the digits a block always holds, zeros included.

symbols.name: place index
symbols.meaning: The position of a digit in a block, running from 0 to L-1, with 0 the least significant place.
symbols.quote: Position $\ell$ runs from $0$ to $L-1$, with $\ell = 0$ the least significant place.

symbols.name: block value
symbols.meaning: The integer stored in a block, from 0 up to B^L minus 1.
symbols.quote: $v$ is the integer stored in the block, the value its digits spell out.

symbols.name: digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of a block at place index ell, an integer from 0 to B minus 1 that multiplies B to the power ell.
symbols.quote: $s_\ell$ is the digit at place $\ell$, an integer from $0$ to $B-1$ that multiplies $B^\ell$ in the sum.

relations.quote: Each fixed-width digit block is a special case of [mixed-radix digits](mixed-radix-digits.md), in which every place has the same length $B$, so that the $L$ places together form the complete digit string.
